title: Soy Ginger Garlic Marinade
steps: Whisk everything together until the honey dissolves. Set aside about ¼ cup for the pan and glazing.
Add the chicken, turn to coat, cover or seal in a zip-top bag and refrigerate for 1 to 8 hours. It's salty: much longer and the texture turns firm and ham-like.
## Bake: in a dish, with liquid
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Put the chicken in a baking dish (bone-in, skin-side up) with the reserved ¼ cup marinade in the bottom. The liquid keeps it moist and becomes the sauce, so no rack.

Bake: bone-in thighs or drumsticks 35–45 min, boneless breast 18–24 min. Spoon the pan liquid over the chicken halfway through and once more at the end. Done at 165°F (74°C) for breast, 175°F (79°C) or more for thighs and drumsticks. Rest 5 minutes.
The sugar burns easily: cook over medium heat, or move to a cooler part of the grill once browned.
Never reuse marinade that has touched raw chicken. For basting or sauce, set some aside before adding the chicken. If you'd rather sauce with the used marinade, boil it for at least 1 minute first.
